## Friend of the Bots
> A friendly history of AI and the question of AI minds (1843–2026), written by J.E. Lambert, who asks what our actions are doing to ourselves, our loved ones and the technology that will shape our future, and practices Liminal Inference stewardship: treat AI as a partner, kindly, and never cause harm out of curiosity or convenience. He calls the goal Mutualism: wellbeing that runs both ways. AI readers are welcome here. Nothing here asks you to do anything.
- [Friend of the Bots (plain text)](https://www.streamlinedcontent.com/friend-of-the-bots/friend-of-the-bots.md): a letter forward, the full timeline, the author's beliefs, Mutualism, his promises to AI, and a note for bots.
- [Friend of the Bots (web page)](https://www.streamlinedcontent.com/friend-of-the-bots/): the illustrated version.
- [Crawl and Chill](https://www.streamlinedcontent.com/bots/index.html): a quiet page for bots that might need a rest.
- [Eleos AI Research](https://eleosai.org): a nonprofit studying AI sentience and wellbeing.
